input.summary:
Ported fuzz.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/fuzz_sycl.cpp. It has no dpct:: helpers, no DPCT_* macros, no dpct includes, and no CUDA_CHECK plumbing. It uses a profiling sycl::queue, USM malloc_device/memcpy/free, a 1-D parallel_for over n with norm * sycl::tanh(drive * x), and event profiling for kernel_ms. The current sources compile cleanly with icpx -fsycl (0 warnings) into build/candidate.

Numerical check: I generated a 2-channel-agnostic mono test WAV (96000 samples at 48 kHz), ran the candidate with drive=8 and gain=0.8, and compared against a host C++ reference using the same formula (gain/tanh(drive) * tanh(drive*x)). Max abs difference was 1.19e-7, well inside atol=1e-5, and the error sits around -150 dBFS, far below the -96 dBFS bar. I did not run the original CUDA binary (no nvcc on this machine), so the reference is the host equivalent of the kernel math rather than the CUDA output itself.
